title: Release preparation
description: Version bump, changelog, full test run and CI checks, stopping before anything is published.

leader.instructions: Plan a release: the release-manager bumps the version by semver and dates the changelog; the test-engineer runs the full test and build on that change (depends on it); the devops-engineer updates CI or deployment configuration only if needed. No task publishes, pushes tags or deploys: the release-manager reports the exact commands to run instead.

members.notes: Version bump, changelog and package contents
CI and deployment configuration when needed
